data.title: Pond Duck Adventures

challenges.instruction: Listen to the story and figure out how many ducks there are now!
challenges.storyText: 3 ducks are swimming in the pond. 2 more ducks join them.

challenges.instruction: Listen to the story and tell me how many ducks are left in the pond.
challenges.storyText: 6 ducks are swimming in the pond. 2 ducks waddle away.

challenges.instruction: Listen to the story and find out how many ducks joined the group.
challenges.storyText: 4 ducks are resting by the water. Some more ducks waddle over and join them, making 7 ducks in total.

challenges.instruction: Listen to the story and figure out how many ducks were there at the very start.
challenges.storyText: Some ducks are swimming in the pond. 4 ducks fly away, leaving 3 ducks behind.

challenges.instruction: Listen to the story and find out how many ducks there are altogether.
challenges.storyText: 5 ducks are swimming in the water and 4 ducks are sitting on the grass.

challenges.instruction: Listen to the story and figure out how many ducks hopped into the pond.
challenges.storyText: 2 ducks are splashing in the water. More ducks arrive, and now there are 8 ducks splashing.

challenges.instruction: Listen to the story and find the starting number of ducks.
challenges.storyText: Some ducks are resting near the reeds. 5 ducks swim away to the middle of the pond, and 5 ducks stay behind.

data.description: Students practice solving addition and subtraction word problems featuring ducks joining and leaving the pond, exploring unknown result, change, and start positions.
